ai_summary: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited's upcoming board meeting will address significant capital-raising initiatives, including a Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) and a preferential issue of equity shares, alongside a proposed further acquisition of Ampivo Smart Technologies. These plans signal a substantial need for capital, which, if approved, will lead to significant shareholder dilution while infusing funds for strategic expansion. Investors should carefully scrutinize the company's underlying financial health and the strategic rationale behind such extensive fundraising.
